title: pid's parse.rs opens a result table three ways; make it one
body: Through its own reader, and twice more by calling a parser directly. Nothing is duplicated, and it is still three shapes to learn (REFACTOR.md, one way per file to do one thing).
close_reason: Commit 028a077: score and cells read through Run from the ledger, with nail_rows for the cell fraction. Proved by byte diff on the pid toy; score.tbl is sorted where it was in hash order.
